default_policy.reason: Combinations not listed in this matrix are not part of the 1.0.0 stable claim.

matrix.user_claim: Primary 1.0.0 Windows desktop target.

matrix.reason: The locked native core and desktop packaging target are Windows x64 only.
matrix.user_claim: No macOS, Linux, Windows ARM64 native, or 32-bit desktop package support in 1.0.0.
Install, cache, corpus, backup, and rollback paths use a local NTFS data root.

matrix.reason: Rollback, path traversal, and corruption semantics are not qualified for remote or rewritten roots.
matrix.user_claim: Network shares, symlink escapes, and cloud-sync controlled roots are not stable targets.
Japanese UTF-8 desktop UI and release-facing documents are the primary 1.0.0 language target.

matrix.reason: Multi-locale UI switching is outside the completed localization scope.
matrix.user_claim: No English or runtime locale-switch stable UI claim.
Primary source and wheel validation runtime.
Compatibility smoke target because the package metadata currently allows Python >=3.10.

matrix.reason: No compatibility evidence exists for PyPy, 32-bit Python, or Python versions above the qualified range.
matrix.user_claim: Explicit reject unless a later issue qualifies the runtime.
Only the locked ocgcore API 11.0 Windows x64 runtime and exact external asset lock are stable.

matrix.reason: Bootstrap and asset verification fail closed on API, architecture, size, or SHA-256 mismatch.
matrix.user_claim: Unknown DLL, CDB, Lua tree, or mismatched API is rejected before stable use.

matrix.reason: License and redistribution approval are not complete.
matrix.user_claim: No third-party core, CDB, CardScripts, card image, or card text assets may be bundled.
Current Experiment, Scenario, Route, Replay, Search, PlayerView, and analytics artifacts are read, validated, and replayed according to their schema.
Old source milestone artifacts are read, replayed, migrated, or explicitly rejected according to version policy.

matrix.reason: Legacy card-text artifacts are not Route DSL input and are not a card rules engine.
matrix.user_claim: No stable compatibility claim for the old card-text transformation pipeline.
Documented CLI commands and the private pywebview invoke bridge are the only stable user-facing interface.

matrix.reason: The desktop bridge contract disables local REST and arbitrary public Python methods.
matrix.user_claim: No public REST API, arbitrary bridge method, or debug-only call support.
Clean install of the Windows x64 desktop package is the primary distribution path.
Upgrade, rollback, uninstall, and reinstall must preserve or explicitly restore user data.

matrix.reason: Unknown required versions and irreversible migrations must not be silently accepted.
matrix.user_claim: Reject unknown new data in old binaries unless an explicit migration or restore path exists.

support_window.active: Until 1.1.0 is released or 12 months after 1.0.0, whichever is later.
support_window.release_notes_requirement: Publish concrete calendar dates in the final 1.0.0 release notes.
